dogecoin.text: I'm not going to make a life changing amount of money off of #dogecoin but buying a little at 0.043 and holding has taught me about crypto, patience in investments, and the importance of a positive supportive community who believes in a common goal. To the moon bbyyyyy
Using @dogecoin to pay for a train ticket to get my second vaccination dose because for whatever reason my city's supply is below demand is the weirdest storyline of 2021 so far
